New in 0.1.4.5 - sand fixes from your feedback:
- Sand no longer vanishes: sand that settled thinly over a wide area stayed invisible (about 9% of a beach after one wave). Thin layers now gather into real sand pixels; after a wave 98% of the sand is back on the ground.
- The sand is now medium beach sand (0.4 mm) instead of very fine sand: it settles about twice as fast, so the brown clouds clear in seconds, not a minute.
